facts.value: Disables one indexed item hit capsule, clears xDAA_flag.b2, then invokes the hit-capsule position/state updater for all four slots. The selected disabled capsule is skipped by that updater; this operation does not clear its victim history or reactivate it.

facts.rationale: Accounts for observable effects of the all-four follow-up rather than describing only the wrapper's direct assignment.
facts.value: Unconditionally disables the requested capsule and clears xDAA_flag.b2 before updating slots 0 through 3. Each remaining Enabled capsule initializes its position pair, advances to Unk2, and sets b2 to one; Unk2 advances to Unk3 and updates positions, while Unk3 updates positions and Disabled/Unk4 are skipped. Thus b2 is not guaranteed to remain cleared. The operation does not change the item's motion-state ID or timer.

facts.value: Receives an Item_GObj*, selects its root JObj's first child with null-root handling, and reads Item.xD44_lifeTimer. It computes (u32)(s32)lifeTimer % it_804D6D28->x44_float. A nonzero remainder clears JOBJ_HIDDEN through the selected hierarchy; zero sets that flag through the hierarchy.

facts.value: Each invocation hides the selected child hierarchy when the integer remainder (u32)(s32)lifeTimer % it_804D6D28->x44_float is zero and reveals it otherwise. The helper neither decrements lifetime nor removes the item. Countdown callers invoke it after their expiration test during the final-lifetime interval, producing periodic hidden pulses.

evidence.why: Exact wrapper signature, guard and controls.
Complete downstream ID handling and conditional handle writes.

facts.rationale: Preserves the verified forwarding behavior while explicitly accounting for both special-ID branches, including the no-op sentinel.
facts.value: Receives an Item pointer and s32 SFX ID. If Item.xDCD_flag.b2 is clear, forwards the same pointer and ID to Item_8026AE84 with controls 0x7F and 0x40; otherwise performs no operation. The callee ignores ID 540000 without changing xD6C. For ID 540001 it requests playback of 540000; for other IDs it maps the ID before requesting playback. Both playback branches store the returned handle in Item.xD6C.

evidence.why: Shows scale multiplication, root-model assignment, and separate x3C forwarding.

facts.rationale: The worker and resolved callees demonstrate two distinct scale sources; preserving that distinction avoids claiming unsupported hitbox/model scale equivalence.
facts.value: Applies the owning fighter's current Y scale to the item's existing scl, assigns the resulting uniform scale to the root model, and multiplies the stored grab-range and auxiliary rectangular bounds by updated scl. Separately refreshes enabled hit-capsule scales from Item.x3C rather than from the computed scl.
